resolution.question: Loomis & Hale LLP signed a new client this morning. Will the two sides agree on a kickoff meeting time within 72 hours of the engagement letter being signed?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-10-09T09:30:00-07:00, the persistent event history shows that both sides have explicitly agreed on a specific date and time for the kickoff meeting (e.g., via email confirmation or calendar invitation acceptance). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
